summary: Runs a .tox component in a separate TouchEngine process, exposing the loaded component's supported top-level inputs, outputs, and custom parameters back to the main TouchDesigner project.

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: .tox component file to load in TouchEngine

key_params.name: reloadoncrash
key_params.note: Restart TouchEngine if the instance quits unexpectedly

key_params.name: assetpaths
key_params.note: Controls relative path resolution inside the loaded component

key_params.name: clock
key_params.note: Synchronized or Independent timing for the TouchEngine instance

key_params.name: matchrate
key_params.note: Cook the loaded component at the Engine COMP rate

key_params.name: wait
key_params.note: Wait for late render output instead of dropping frames

key_params.name: timeout
key_params.note: Maximum wait time for a render frame

key_params.name: readywhen
key_params.note: Condition that marks the loaded component ready

key_params.name: startoninit
key_params.note: Start playback as soon as initialization reaches ready state

key_params.name: allowui
key_params.note: Allow loaded components to open Window COMPs or Perform Mode

key_concepts: Engine COMP loads a .tox component into a separate TouchEngine process and exposes its supported top-level interfaces to the host project.
Only top-level TOP, CHOP, and DAT inputs and outputs are supported through the Engine COMP interface.
Unload, Reload, Reload on Crash, and advanced launch/quit controls manage the lifetime of the loaded TouchEngine process.
Asset Paths and exposed file/folder parameters control whether relative paths resolve beside the .tox or relative to the main project.
TouchEngine lifetime differs from normal TouchDesigner startup: Execute DAT onStart/onExit do not run, so setup that must run on load belongs in onCreate.
common_gotchas: Only TOP, CHOP, and DAT top-level inputs and outputs are supported through the Engine COMP interface.
Custom parameters exposed on the Engine COMP are one-way; the loaded .tox cannot set them from inside TouchEngine.
Custom parameters that refer to other nodes are not supported; pass those nodes through inputs instead.
Relative paths inside the loaded component can resolve relative to the .tox or project depending on Asset Paths, while exposed file/folder parameters resolve relative to the main project.
Execute DAT onStart() and onExit() do not run under TouchEngine; use onCreate() for setup that must happen when loaded.
Loaded components that open UI require Independent clock mode so UI events are serviced.
